lines: overnight is a Claude Code plugin with a command that runs the pieces of work you give it in
Claude Code while you're away, one after another, and resumes each by itself after the usage limit
or an error stops it.
overnight is for you when you hand Claude Code work that runs for hours and leave it running at
night. With it, you find each piece of work done by morning, or recorded as failed with its log,
without getting up to type "continue" once the limit lifts or to start the next.
- overnight doesn't resume a conversation that you have open in Claude Code: it runs work that it
- overnight doesn't run from a terminal outside Claude Code: Claude Code puts the command on the
- overnight doesn't keep your computer awake: before you leave, set the computer not to sleep while
In development, at 0.1.0: overnight runs the pieces of work you add one at a time, in the order
you add them, and starts the next when one ends. No real night has yet carried a work through this
version. It doesn't yet run more than one at once, or start work at a given time.

overnight runs your pieces of work in Claude Code without you, one after another, and each time a
run stops short, it waits and asks Claude to go on in the same conversation, until the work is done
or the retries run out, then starts the next.
